description: **The project describes itself consistently on PyPI, npm and in its README.** The registry listings carried a terse tagline with no project URLs, no classifiers and no homepage, and the README opened without saying what predraw is.

**Documentation links point at the unified site.** The declared docs base was the retired per-project host; it is `https://smmh.dev/predraw/` now, so generated sitemaps, feeds and llms.txt name the address that serves the pages.
